title: FROM clause plus JOIN, APPLY, PIVOT (Transact-SQL)
contentRelevance: For classic SQL Server 2016+ relational queries, INNER JOIN returns matching row pairs and CROSS JOIN returns the Cartesian product. This supports staged chunk-to-document correlation and multiplicity without invoking AI producer functions or comparing native vectors.
